diagnostics.message: [zielinski2019] sec. 2.4 reports two durations without stating how they relate: 'Cells were grown for 15-16 h at 37 C' and 'After induction, the culture was grown for 4-5 h until OD600 nm was about 50-60'. Whether 15-16 h is the total batch duration or the pre-induction duration is not stated, and the two readings differ by 4-5 h. The digitized Fig. 3 axis ends at 19 h, which is consistent with a total of about 19-21 h under the second reading but does not settle it. Both durations are stored as reported intervals and neither is adjusted.

diagnostics.message: [zielinski2019] The narrative order in sec. 2.4 cannot be reconciled with Fig. 3. Glucose feeding is limited once OD600 reaches 25-35, which the digitized curve places at about 13.1 h; but a 4-5 h post-induction phase ending at OD600 50-60 (reached at about 15.7 h) would place induction at about 10.7-11.7 h, i.e. BEFORE the glucose limitation. The induction time is not stated, so the conflict is recorded rather than resolved.

reading_guide.note: Mechanical validity, semantic compatibility, execution success and scientific validation are four different questions. None of them answers any of the others, and the report never lets one stand in for another.

graph.title: Zielinski et al. (2019) recombinant human insulin process — evidence replay
graph.notes: Evidence replay is not a simulation. The model restates the paper's reported numbers, applies the accounting identities the paper supports, and publishes the Fig. 3 digitized growth trajectory with its declared uncertainty. It reports no kinetic parameter, no oxygen transfer and no spatial field, so nothing downstream of this graph may present a simulated concentration, velocity or temperature field.

execution.note: Every instance ran. The warnings are findings about the sources or the models, not failures of the composition.

models.basis: A model that publishes no validation claim through this boundary is reported as not documented. This is neither a validated model nor an unvalidated one.

declared_missing_models.label: Biomass growth differential equation
declared_missing_models.why_needed: To predict OD600 or biomass from medium composition and feed rates.
declared_missing_models.why_not_implemented: The paper reports no kinetic parameters, no mu_max, no Ks and no oxygen-transfer data. Fitting a curve to the single Fig. 3 batch would be a fitted mechanistic model, not a sourced one.

declared_missing_models.label: Monod substrate uptake
declared_missing_models.why_needed: To predict glucose consumption and feed volume from pH-stat control.
declared_missing_models.why_not_implemented: The paper gives only the controlled concentration ranges (70-120 and 30-50 mg/dL), never the feed rate or saturation constants needed to solve an uptake model.

declared_missing_models.label: Oxygen transfer (kLa)
declared_missing_models.why_needed: To predict dissolved oxygen and whether growth is oxygen limited.
declared_missing_models.why_not_implemented: No gas-flow, agitation or dissolved-oxygen data appear anywhere in the paper. CFD/mixing/heat-transfer simulation is out of scope.

declared_missing_models.label: Renaturation folding kinetics
declared_missing_models.why_needed: To predict refolding yield or time from temperature, pH or redox.
declared_missing_models.why_not_implemented: The paper explicitly reports that refolding 'was shown to depend on the redox potential and the pH value, but not on the temperature' (sec. 4.5), which contradicts reading temperature as the causal predictor. Two yields at two temperatures are not a yield function.

declared_missing_models.label: AU to protein mass calibration
declared_missing_models.why_needed: To convert any AU measurement into grams or mg of protein.
declared_missing_models.why_not_implemented: sec. 2.18 states the spectrophotometer was calibrated with water. Without a path length and an extinction coefficient the absorbance scale is undefined, so every AU value is instrument-relative.

declared_missing_models.label: Per-stage purification recovery
declared_missing_models.why_needed: To predict downstream yield from upstream AU or mass.
declared_missing_models.why_not_implemented: Inventing recovery efficiencies is explicitly out of scope, and the AU basis differs between stages (total protein at 280 nm vs. the insulin-containing fraction), so an AU ratio is not a recovery.

declared_missing_models.label: Biological activity from absorbance
declared_missing_models.why_needed: To convert the final AU stream into IU/L.
declared_missing_models.why_not_implemented: The paper reports activity only as a retrospective average of 2700 IU per litre of culture medium; it gives no relation between that figure and any absorbance measurement.

declared_missing_models.label: Scale-up correlation
declared_missing_models.why_needed: To project the 4 L laboratory result onto larger fermenters.
declared_missing_models.why_not_implemented: Out of scope by instruction, and unsupportable: the paper reports a single laboratory scale with no scale-down/up correlation.

assumptions.statement: 'diluted 2 times with H2O' is read as a final volume of 2 x the starting volume.
assumptions.rationale: The paper applies this same phrase in secs. 2.11 and 2.15. Under this reading the DEAE fraction of 250 mL becomes 500 mL, and the paper's own ZnCl2 formula (2 x V/100) then reproduces the reported 10 mL exactly. Reading it as a final volume of 250 mL would give 5 mL, which contradicts sec. 4.9. The alternative reading is therefore not used.

assumptions.statement: Crossing times on the growth trajectory are linearly interpolated between adjacent digitized markers.
assumptions.rationale: Needed to locate when the digitized OD600 curve passes a reported OD600 threshold. Linear interpolation over the 1 h sampling interval is the least-assuming choice, but it is an assumption: the true curve is only known at the sampled points.

limitations.source: the model's own manifest, as published through --describe-model

combined_graph.basis: Composing these models produces a system that no published source has evaluated. Validation evidence for an individual model is a statement about that model and does not transfer to the composition, so the combined graph starts from 'not established' and can only be changed by an independent evaluation.
combined_graph.execution_is_not_validation: A successful execution is evidence that the pipeline works. It is not evidence that the numbers are right, and nothing in this report upgrades a model's reproduction_status because a test passed.
